english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone or something cut off from the outside world.
Use this when the emphasis is on being cut off or isolated from the outside world, rather than specifically on narrow-mindedness.

examples.english: The hut on that mountain is cloistered and cannot even get a phone signal.
examples.traditional: 嗰座山上嘅小屋與世隔絕，手機訊號都收唔到。
examples.jyutping: go2 zo6 saan1 soeng6 ge3 siu2 uk1 jyu5 sai3 gaak3 zyut6 sau2 gei1 seon3 hou6 dou1 sau1 m4 dou3

examples.english: That mountain village is so remote that it is almost insular.
